source_citations.provider: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) — Atmosphere Data Store (ADS)

transformation_rule: Slice CAMS European regional ensemble analysis NetCDF grid (37.0-40.5N, 19.0-22.0E, level=0m) at nearest grid point to Corfu International Airport (39.65N, 19.95E) and compute regional mean/max. Note: CAMS regional does not include CO2; NO2 and CO are retained as combustion proxies while point CO2 awaits local IoT sensors.

refined_data.corfu_airport.lat.description: Latitude of nearest CAMS grid cell to Corfu Airport (CFU).

refined_data.corfu_airport.lon.description: Longitude of nearest CAMS grid cell to Corfu Airport (CFU).

refined_data.values_ug_m3.NO2.at_corfu_a.description: Surface NO2 concentration at Corfu Airport grid cell (combustion proxy for airport emissions).

refined_data.values_ug_m3.CO.at_corfu_ai.description: Surface CO concentration at Corfu Airport grid cell.

refined_data.values_ug_m3.PM10.at_corfu_.description: Surface PM10 concentration at Corfu Airport grid cell.

refined_data.values_ug_m3.PM2.5.at_corfu.description: Surface PM2.5 concentration at Corfu Airport grid cell.

refined_data.source: CAMS European air quality forecasts (ADS), ensemble analysis
refined_data.note: CO2 is NOT a CAMS regional variable; nearest airport-level pollutants are NO2/PM10/PM2.5/CO.
